name: upstream_row_visible
args: t uuid, c uuid, p uuid, typ text, sid uuid
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.upstream_row_visible(t uuid, c uuid, p uuid, typ text, sid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE visible boolean;
BEGIN
 IF NOT typ=ANY(ARRAY['uploaded_originals','artifact_versions','definition_revisions',
  'product_variants','projects','plan_proposals','bom_revisions','engineering_configurations'])
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 EXECUTE format('SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.%I
  WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND category_id=$2 AND product_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3 AND id=$4)',typ)
 INTO visible USING t,c,p,sid;
 RETURN visible;
END $function$
